compiled_state.title: [ci-llm-review]: haiku model returns prose instead of JSON -> fallback chain exhausted, no review findings
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

**observed_behavior:** In CI (PR #55), `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` returned 1911 characters of non-JSON prose despite the system prompt in `dispatch.py` instructing it to return ONLY a JSON object. This exhausts the fallback chain and produces zero real review findings.

**expected_behavior:** The model should return a JSON object matching the findings schema. The llm-review CI job should produce actual review findings.

**error_message:** `Fallback chain exhausted for agent code-reviewer-standard (primary=claude-haiku-4-5-20251001): LLM returned non-JSON response (length=1911); cannot parse as findings.`

**code_version:** fa853d25d3499eca195e7c3a7ef5c796577e2c8b

**reproduction:** Submit a PR to main; the llm-review job will hit haiku, which returns prose, exhausting the fallback chain.

comments.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 3 (INTERMEDIATE) — severity:1 (functional degradation, no review findings), complexity:1 (dispatch.py fallback chain + JSON parsing), environment:1 (CI failure), intermittent:0 (deterministic). Compound bug check: single coherent issue — haiku returning prose instead of JSON. Intent gate: skipping intent-search (this is a user-reported CLI_user-equivalent observation from CI empirical evidence). Feature-Request gate: N/A (intent-aligned).
comments.author: Test

comments.body:
Hypothesis approved (Phase D). Approved fixes:
A: Wire _extract_json_from_text() into _parse_response() — use existing robust extractor
C: Tier-to-model mapping from dso config (provider-agnostic; matching local review tier models: haiku=light, sonnet=standard/deep); not hardcoded
F: Emit error to stderr when _parse_response() fails (make failure loud in CI logs even when job exits 0)
comments.author: Test
